name: Learning-Space Graphs Are Partial Cubes
scope: Finite learning spaces and their one-inclusion graphs.
statement: Every learning-space graph is a partial cube.
proof: For states $A,B$, accessibility gives deletion chains and union closure transports them to tight paths from $A$ through $A\cup B$ to $B$. The path length is $|A\mathbin\triangle B|$, so the one-inclusion graph is isometric in its Boolean cube.
